text: For the sabbath-day. the day before the Sabbath, when the land was first inhabited, the praise of a Song by David.
Thy throne is prepared of old: thou art from everlasting.
The rivers have lifted up, O Lord, the rivers have lifted up their voices, See Heb.
at in answer to. the voices of many waters: the billows of the sea are wonderful: the Lord is wonderful in high places.
Thy testimonies are made very sure: holiness becomes thine house, O Lord, for ever.
